title: A Partial's #line directives name the module's project-relative source file
claim: Verdict: kept. The generated `a/ceedling_partial_util_impl.c` holds `#line 4 "src/a/util.c"` ahead of the function, the path as the project spells it. The coverage plugins' retargeting of Partial coverage onto the original relies on that path. Not run with a coverage tool.
